capabilities.name: core.runtime
capabilities.description: The language-neutral DLUMA runtime and owner model are available.

capabilities.name: core.timers
capabilities.description: Owner-bound game-thread timers are available.

capabilities.name: world.find
capabilities.description: Exact-name world object lookup is validated for the running build.

capabilities.name: world.local_enable
capabilities.description: Local object enable state can be read and changed.

capabilities.name: world.position
capabilities.description: Copied object transforms can be read.

capabilities.name: player.read
capabilities.description: A generation-bound local-player handle and allowlisted variables are available.

capabilities.name: player.transform
capabilities.description: Copied local-player position and directions can be read.

capabilities.name: player.vitals
capabilities.description: Validated local-player health and alive-state access is available.

capabilities.name: player.vehicle
capabilities.description: Copied local-player vehicle state is available for the running exact build.

capabilities.name: events.sensor
capabilities.description: Named sensor state and edge events are available.

capabilities.name: events.interact
capabilities.description: Validated interaction observations are available.

capabilities.name: events.enemy_killed
capabilities.description: Copied post-death events are available.

capabilities.name: ui.subtitles
capabilities.description: Loader-owned subtitle presentation is available.

capabilities.name: ui.quest_hud
capabilities.description: Copied quest HUD state and presentation-only overrides are available.

capabilities.name: ui.overlay
capabilities.description: Loader overlay widgets are available.

capabilities.name: ui.surface
capabilities.description: Owner-bound RGBA HUD surfaces are available for the current game build.

capabilities.name: audio.radio_dialog
capabilities.description: Named radio-dialog playback is available.

capabilities.name: audio.registered_cues
capabilities.description: Registered 2D and positional cue playback is available.

capabilities.name: audio.stem
capabilities.description: Owner-bound companion stem playback is available.

capabilities.name: audio.wave_filter
capabilities.description: Exact-build per-wave wet-mix and cutoff control is available.

capabilities.name: audio.music_exclusive
capabilities.description: Transactional exclusive ownership of stock music is available.

capabilities.name: audio.music_filter
capabilities.description: Exact-build restorable stock-music filter control is available.

capabilities.name: quests.native
capabilities.description: Validated native quest transitions are available.

capabilities.name: quests.phase_handlers
capabilities.description: Manifest-declared custom quest phase providers and observers can receive copied local phase-entry events.

capabilities.name: actions.chain
capabilities.description: Exact-name authored ActionChain execution is available.

capabilities.name: configuration.mod
capabilities.description: Typed manifest-declared mod configuration is available.

capabilities.name: storage.mod
capabilities.description: Owner-isolated persistent scalar storage is available.

capabilities.name: companion.content
capabilities.description: Approval-bound companion content snapshots are available.

access.name: game.read
access.description: Read copied game state through validated DLUMA services.

access.name: world.query
access.description: Resolve and inspect exact named world objects.

access.name: ui.overlay
access.description: Present loader-owned UI without changing game state.

access.name: audio.play
access.description: Play approved audio through bounded DLUMA services.

access.name: quest.write
access.description: Request validated transitions in pre-authored native quests.

access.name: storage.mod
access.description: Read and write owner-isolated persistent scalar storage.

access.name: companion.read
access.description: Read approval-bound files from declared companion content.

access.name: quest.phase.handle
access.description: Provide local behavior for manifest-declared custom quest phase contracts.

access.name: quest.phase.observe
access.description: Observe local custom quest phase contracts after their primary provider.

access.name: editor.quest.extend
access.description: Run approved pointer-free validators for declared quest phase handlers inside Chrome Editor.

types.name: DlumaNoRequest
types.documentation: A size-prefixed request with no payload.

types.name: DlumaCallResult
types.documentation: The common size-prefixed operation result.

types.name: DlumaBoolResult
types.documentation: A common result containing one boolean value.

types.name: DlumaU64Result
types.documentation: A common result containing one unsigned 64-bit value.

types.name: DlumaFloatResult
types.documentation: A common result containing one floating-point value.

types.name: DlumaVec3Result
types.documentation: A copied three-dimensional vector result.

types.name: DlumaLogRequest
types.documentation: A bounded UTF-8 log request.

types.name: DlumaCapabilityQueryRequest
types.documentation: Queries one stable generated capability ID.

types.name: DlumaCapabilityQueryResult
types.documentation: The configured and currently ready state of one capability.

types.name: DlumaTimerRequest
types.documentation: Requests one owner-bound timer.

types.name: DlumaTokenRequest
types.documentation: Addresses one owner-bound callback, subscription, timer, or resource token.

types.name: DlumaTokenResult
types.documentation: Returns one owner-bound token.

types.name: DlumaWorldFindRequest
types.documentation: Finds an exact runtime object name with an optional class constraint.

types.name: DlumaObjectResult
types.documentation: Returns a generation- and owner-bound opaque object handle.

types.name: DlumaObjectRequest
types.documentation: Addresses an opaque object handle.

types.name: DlumaSetEnabledManyRequest
types.documentation: Requests a bounded local-enable operation for exact object names.

types.name: DlumaSetEnabledManyResult
types.documentation: Summarizes a bounded local-enable operation.

types.name: DlumaPlayerVariableRequest
types.documentation: Addresses one allowlisted PlayerVariables value.

types.name: DlumaPlayerVariableSetRequest
types.documentation: Sets one bounded transient PlayerVariables override.

types.name: DlumaPlayerVariableResult
types.documentation: A copied allowlisted PlayerVariables snapshot.

types.name: DlumaStringListResult
types.documentation: Writes a bounded list of UTF-8 strings into caller-provided views.

types.name: DlumaNamedRequest
types.documentation: Addresses one exact UTF-8 game or authored name.

types.name: DlumaEventSubscribeRequest
types.documentation: Subscribes an owner callback, optionally filtered by exact name.

types.name: DlumaSubtitleRequest
types.documentation: Shows a bounded loader-owned subtitle.

types.name: DlumaSubtitleUpdateRequest
types.documentation: Updates the active loader-owned subtitle.

types.name: DlumaQuestHudRequest
types.documentation: Requests a copied quest HUD snapshot.

types.name: DlumaQuestHudResult
types.documentation: Returns a canonical JSON copy of the bounded quest HUD snapshot.

types.name: DlumaQuestHudOverrideRequest
types.documentation: Sets or updates one presentation-only quest HUD override.

types.name: DlumaRadioDialogRequest
types.documentation: Starts one exact named speaker group.

types.name: DlumaAudioPlayRequest
types.documentation: Plays an approved cue with copied position and gain.

types.name: DlumaQuestTransitionRequest
types.documentation: Requests a transition in a pre-authored native quest.

types.name: DlumaConfigGetRequest
types.documentation: Reads one manifest-declared configuration key.

types.name: DlumaScalarResult
types.documentation: Returns one copied typed scalar.

types.name: DlumaStorageGetRequest
types.documentation: Reads one owner-isolated storage key.

types.name: DlumaStorageSetRequest
types.documentation: Writes one owner-isolated scalar storage value.

types.name: DlumaCompanionOpenRequest
types.documentation: Opens an approval-bound immutable companion artifact.

types.name: DlumaCompanionOpenResult
types.documentation: Returns an owner-bound immutable companion artifact token and metadata.

types.name: DlumaVehicleStateResult
types.documentation: Returns copied local-player and vehicle state without exposing an engine pointer.

types.name: DlumaCompanionEntryReadRequest
types.documentation: Reads one canonical entry from an opened approval-bound companion archive.

types.name: DlumaCompanionEntryReadResult
types.documentation: Copies one bounded binary companion entry into caller-owned storage.

types.name: DlumaAudioBankOpenRequest
types.documentation: Opens one manifest-allowlisted bank from an approved companion archive.

types.name: DlumaAudioCueRequest
types.documentation: Addresses one allowlisted cue in an opened companion bank.

types.name: DlumaAudioCuePlayRequest
types.documentation: Starts one owner-bound allowlisted companion cue.

types.name: DlumaAudioCueStateResult
types.documentation: Returns copied playback state for one owner-bound cue.

types.name: DlumaAudioCueSeekRequest
types.documentation: Seeks one owner-bound cue to a bounded millisecond position.

types.name: DlumaAudioCueGainRequest
types.documentation: Sets bounded gain for one owner-bound cue.

types.name: DlumaAudioFilterRequest
types.documentation: Sets bounded wet-mix and cutoff values for an owner-bound audio token.

types.name: DlumaAudioCueStopRequest
types.documentation: Stops one owner-bound cue with an optional bounded fade.

types.name: DlumaAudioMusicAcquireRequest
types.documentation: Requests process-exclusive stock-music ownership with a bounded fade.

types.name: DlumaAudioMusicStateResult
types.documentation: Returns the phase of one owner-bound exclusive music lease.

types.name: DlumaAudioMusicReleaseRequest
types.documentation: Releases exclusive music ownership and schedules bounded stock-music resume.

types.name: DlumaQuestPhaseRegistrationRequest
types.documentation: Registers one owner-bound custom quest phase callback ID for a declared handler or contract.

types.name: DlumaHudSurfaceCreateRequest
types.documentation: Creates an RGBA8 HUD surface.

types.name: DlumaHudSurfaceUpdateRequest
types.documentation: Copies RGBA8 pixels into an owned HUD surface.

types.name: DlumaHudSurfaceLayoutRequest
types.documentation: Sets HUD rectangle in 1280 by 720 coordinates.

types.name: DlumaHudSurfaceVisibilityRequest
types.documentation: Sets HUD surface visibility.

types.name: DlumaHudSurfaceSuppressRequest
types.documentation: Sets the owned stock HUD suppression mask.

operations.documentation: Writes a bounded owner-attributed message to the loader log.
Queries configured support and current readiness for one stable capability ID.
Returns the loader monotonic clock in milliseconds.
Schedules one owner-bound callback after a positive delay.
Schedules one repeating owner-bound callback.
Idempotently cancels an owner-bound timer, subscription, callback, or resource token.
Finds an exact runtime object name and returns an opaque owner- and generation-bound handle.
Returns a copied object position after ownership, identity, and generation revalidation.
Returns a copied normalized object forward direction.
Returns the copied local-enable state for an opaque object handle.
Applies a bounded local-enable change to exact object names.
Returns the opaque generation-bound local-player handle.
Returns a copied local-player position.
Returns a copied normalized local-player look direction.
Returns a copied normalized local-player body direction.
Returns copied current local-player health.
Returns computed maximum local-player health when an independently validated PlayerDI vitals binding is ready; this is never substituted with a raw PlayerVariable.
Returns the validated local-player alive state.
Lists the generated allowlist of named PlayerVariables.
Reads one copied allowlisted raw PlayerVariables tuning snapshot. Names such as max_health and base_max_health are not current health or the computed PlayerDI maximum-health result.
Transactionally applies one bounded transient allowlisted raw PlayerVariables tuning override; invalid or non-finite derived values leave game memory unchanged.
Restores one transient PlayerVariables override owned by the mod.
Returns copied local-player vehicle state without exposing an engine pointer.
Subscribes a callback to the bounded game-thread frame dispatcher.
Returns whether the local player is inside an exact named SensorArea.
Subscribes to deduplicated enter edges for one exact named SensorArea.
Subscribes to deduplicated leave edges for one exact named SensorArea.
Subscribes to successful base InteractiveItem trigger observations.
Reserved copied post-death event; unavailable until its exact observer is validated.
Shows a bounded loader-owned subtitle.
Updates the active loader-owned subtitle.
Returns a bounded copied view of the current quest HUD.
Creates or updates one presentation-only quest HUD override.
Reserved loader-overlay toast operation.
Starts one exact named dialog speaker group.
Starts one owner-bound allowlisted cue from an opened companion bank.
Stops one owner-bound companion cue with an optional bounded fade.
Opens one manifest-allowlisted CSB bank from an approved companion archive.
Returns the probed millisecond duration of one allowlisted cue.
Returns copied playback state for one owner-bound cue.
Seeks one owner-bound cue to a bounded millisecond position.
Sets bounded gain for one owner-bound cue.
Sets exact-build filter values for one owner-bound cue.
Acquires process-exclusive stock-music ownership transactionally.
Returns the current phase of an owner-bound exclusive music lease.
Sets restorable exact-build filter values for an exclusive stock-music lease.
Restores and releases an exclusive stock-music lease with bounded delayed resume.
Queues an exact engine-synchronized transition to a pre-authored phase.
Removed until a separately validated native start route exists.
Runs one exact active-map ActionChain after its native authored condition succeeds.
Reads one typed player preference declared by the shared manifest.
Subscribes to copied changes for manifest-declared configuration.
Reads one owner-isolated persistent scalar value.
Persists one owner-isolated boolean, number, integer, or UTF-8 string.
Deletes one owner-isolated persistent scalar value.
Opens one declared approval-bound companion artifact by canonical package-relative path.
Copies one canonical stored entry from an opened approval-bound companion archive.
Registers the primary callback for one handler declared by the calling mod manifest.
Registers an observer callback for one provider and handler contract ID.
Idempotently unregisters one quest phase token owned by the calling mod.
Creates an owner-bound map-generation HUD surface.
Copies a complete RGBA8 frame synchronously.
Sets a HUD rectangle in 1280 by 720 coordinates.
Shows or hides the owned HUD surface.
Sets the owner-controlled stock combat HUD suppression mask.
Releases an owned HUD surface and restores suppressed controls.
